title: Core plugin registry and graph extension API
description: Add isolated plugin, element type, relation type, validator, and generic extension graph registries without embedding lifecycle vocabulary in Core.
decision_notes: Independent createArchMap instances clone the built-in view registry; the default instance shares the legacy top-level registry.
Core stores plugin-owned records as inert ExtensionGraph data and does not import lifecycle vocabulary.
Plugin installation is versioned, idempotent for the same version, conflict-aware, dependency-aware, reversible, and isolated.
Policies, serializers, importers, exporters, overlays, and themes receive additive registry foundations without domain behavior in Core.
